name: Boot time and uptime
plain: Reads time since boot; the boot timestamp itself is a classic stable ID until restart.
meaning: now minus uptime gives a boot timestamp that stays constant until reboot and is near-unique across devices. That is why Apple made it a Required Reason API.

android.note: Millisecond resolution; boot count is an integer

limits.headline: Can see how long your phone has been on, and on Android its restart count
limits.user_action: Nothing. The app checks when it starts
can: See time since the last restart on Android, to the millisecond
See the boot count on Android 7 and newer
Use the restart time as a rough ID until the next restart
cannot: Use boot time on iPhone without a stated reason; Apple has enforced a reason rule since 1 May 2024
Keep a stable ID after you restart the phone
Learn what you did before the restart
limits.differs: Android shares uptime with no prompt. iPhone only allows it for approved reasons that developers must declare.

story.what_it_is: An app can work out the exact moment your phone last restarted.

marketing.name: Required Reason APIs
marketing.pitch: Developer rules: apps that read system boot time must declare an approved reason in their privacy manifest.

story.for_you: You never see it. Subtract uptime from the clock and you get the time you rebooted. That time stays the same for days, so it can act as a tag until you restart.
story.for_makers: Makers use it to measure startup speed and spot reboots after crashes. Trackers used it as a near unique ID, which is why Apple made it a Required Reason API.

use_cases.example: A game checks uptime to see if a crash happened after a restart, and uses it to fix freezes.
A crash tool shows that most failures happen soon after a reboot.
A fraud tool notes that two logins share the same boot time and flags a copied device.
An ad partner joins sessions with the same boot time into one device.
A bank detects a time jump that suggests the clock was changed to cheat a code.
A developer measures cold start time of the app after the phone restarts.

risks: Works like a short term ID
story.android_note: Available with no prompt through system uptime.
story.ios_note: Apps must give an approved reason or Apple may reject them.

technical_bounds: Fingerprinting banned by Apple even with reasons

history.change: System boot time is a Required Reason API
